name: deployment_planning
description: Produces a deployment plan from an execution plan and the target environment spec. Defines the build, staging, deployment, and rollback steps for each environment.

outputs.name: deployment_plan
outputs.description: { environment, build_steps: [{step_id, command, artifact}], deploy_steps, health_checks, rollback_steps }

error_codes.message: Target environment has no configured profile.
error_codes.recovery: Suggest creating the environment profile; offer a default scaffold.

examples: execution_plan for code change + environments=[staging, production] -> deployment_plan with staged rollout.
